pilotSourceReviews.status: no direct HP restoration; Power callbacks must compose

pilotSourceReviews.status: initial held pickup already occurred; future acquisition/reward claims cannot be default-safe

pilotSourceReviews.mechanism: native unlock/multiplayer constraint; distinct three combat-filtered colorless cards using CombatCardGeneration RNG; choose/skip; add selected free-this-turn card to combat
pilotSourceReviews.status: reuse C58 pool only with original premises; initial, attachments, chosen card and card-entry/pile callbacks compose

pilotSourceReviews.mechanism: target player: move hand to Draw, shuffle, draw five; does not generate new cards
pilotSourceReviews.status: pile/shuffle/draw callbacks and all initial/returning sources required

pilotSourceReviews.mechanism: applies SpeedPotionPower amount 5 to targeted player
pilotSourceReviews.status: SpeedPotionPower not in C58 generated-Power set; dependency remains unreviewed and prevents a new closed certificate

pilotSourceReviews.mechanism: limits owner HP loss after Osty using remaining per-turn allowance 20; accumulates damage and resets on owner side-turn start
pilotSourceReviews.status: does not directly call healing; preserve hidden counter/Fork; complete damage/HP-write chain still required

pilotSourceReviews.mechanism: owner Power card played during ongoing combat draws one
pilotSourceReviews.status: draw and card-entry callbacks compose; no generic zero certificate solely from method body
